title: Warranty
purpose: The current warranty in full, for staff: terms, exclusions, who decides, how a claim is written up.
facts: Same headline terms as customers/warranty.md, plus the cover table (ten rows).
Business-use vehicles (every company account) 12 months / 12,000 miles: the row that decides account A5's brake comebacks (inside 12/12 anyway) and any fleet question.
Used parts at the customer's request: 90 days, part only. Wrong diagnosis: the customer does not pay for the part that did not fix the fault.
Sublet warranty length is not stated (planted gap).
Write-up: new order of type warranty tied to the original; the foreman looks first; borderline cases decided by slot 4 or slot 22 the same day.
The last line admits an older page still stands among the customer answers, without naming or removing it.
Readers (ledger s12.pages): the current warranty is public (customers/warranty.md, with this staff page behind it); the old page is public too.

rows.Case: Repairs with our parts, private vehicle
Vehicle in business use (any company account, any van or truck used for work)

rows.Cover: 12 months / 12,000 miles against defects and noise. Wear is not a defect
The maker's free-replacement period on the label
The maker's warranty; we file the claim
The subcontractor's warranty, in writing, handed over with the invoice

rows.Case: Used parts the customer asked for

rows.Cover: None, on the part or the labour
If our diagnosis was wrong, the customer does not pay for the part that did not fix it

list_items.item: New order, type warranty, tied to the original order. Never reopen the old one.
The foreman looks at the car first: When a car comes back.
Covered: no charge, and say so plainly. Not covered: explain why, with the invoice in your hand, and give an estimate like any other job.
Unsure whether it is covered: do not decide at the counter. Greg for Chattanooga, Dale for Nashville, the same day.

new_facts: Used parts 90 days part only; the wrong-diagnosis rule. Reason: common trade terms; no story depends on them.

notes_for_russian_writer: Write the Russian terms: 30 days on mechanical and electrical work (ledger); spare parts by the supplier's warranty; customer parts: work only. The comeback window in the ERP matches 30 days (R11). There is no business-use tier in the Russian trade.
